findings.disposition_rationale: findRoot() in shared-infra.js never throws: it walks up from cwd and returns the start directory when nothing matches, and mainWorktreeRoot() uses spawnSync, which returns a non-zero status rather than throwing, and the helper returns null.

The spec fixes the order (run copy, then store copy) and routes a failed second write to exit 1, which every caller reads as needs-human, so a divergent pair cannot pass the gate. The identity check races only if two spawners share one store key, and the key is the issue id, so that is not a supported topology.
The unparseable file is renamed aside, never deleted, as the spec requires; a failed write after the rename leaves the original bytes under the aside name and the next run writes a fresh record.
